text:
support_james: Incoming escalation from VeloxApp — their Console shows TTFT missing for some routes and tokens/sec negative for the last ~2h. They also saw 401s from the /v1/embeddings endpoint when we tried to repro. Customer is panicked, billing impacted. Can eng take a look?

alex_k: Thanks James — grabbing logs. Did they report any deploy time?

support_james: Velox says issue started ~2026-02-11T02:20Z. We flipped a service token earlier for metrics ingestion at ~02:15Z (internal change). Not sure if related.

priya: Noted. I can check the metrics pipeline and Kafka consumer groups. On it.

engops-bot: Deploy event: service-account-rotation v2 -> v3 at 2026-02-11T02:15:07Z by ops/rotation-job (link: https://deploys.internal/rotations/549). No other infra deploys in window.

alex_k: Repro steps from our side: 1) call /v1/embeddings with valid API key -> sometimes 200, sometimes 401. 2) Query streaming rollup: SELECT * FROM metrics.rollup WHERE tenant='velox' AND metric='tokens_sec' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20 -> contains negative deltas and null TTFT rows. Pasting sample rows:
```
ts: 2026-02-11T02:22:00Z, tokens_sec: -124, window_count: 0
ts: 2026-02-11T02:21:00Z, tokens_sec: null, window_count: 0
```

ana_p: (product) If the console shows negative tokens/sec that usually means the raw counter rolled back or we lost some prefix KV causing delta calc to clamp incorrectly. But 401s on API calls suggests auth issue upstream. Could be metrics ingest failing, causing aggregator fallback to stale offsets.

priya: I looked at Kafka consumer group velox-metrics-agg: consumer lag jumped at 02:17Z and we see AuthorizationFailed exceptions in the metrics-ingest logs right after the rotation. Log excerpt:
```
[02:15:09] ERROR auth: token verification failed: token not recognized (service-account v3)
[02:15:09] WARN consumer: AuthorizationFailed: group=velox-metrics-agg, partitions=[5,6,7]
[02:17:02] INFO consumer: rebalanced -> consuming from earliest? offset rollover detected
```
Looks like the ingest pipeline started failing auth, consumer restarted and read from an earlier offset, producing negative deltas when aggregator computes difference.

monitoring_bot: Alert: metrics-ingest errors > 100/m, triggered 02:16Z -> 02:40Z.

alex_k: That aligns. So root cause hypothesis: service-account rotation invalidated metrics-ingest credentials temporarily; consumers restarted and reprocessed older messages or reset offsets -> delta calc produced negative tokens/sec and missing TTFT windows. Also, API 401s reported by customer may be due to a separate key rotation for embedding proxies at the same time or a proxy auth cache issue. We need to confirm which rotation touched the embedding proxy.

support_james: Velox says they saw errors in client logs like: "token rejected: unknown key" and some retries.

priya: Mitigation plan: 1) Re-apply previous service-account token as a hotfix to metrics-ingest (rollback rotation) to stop AuthorizationFailed. 2) Once ingest pipeline stable, re-run a targeted reprocess for Velox topic from stored checkpoint to correct negative deltas (backfill only the affected 02:00-03:00 window). 3) Add a delta-clamp at aggregator to treat large negative deltas as reset and emit null/0 instead of negative values to prevent billing/chart confusion.

ana_p: Can we also surface a "data gap" annotation in the console for Velox so their support dashboard doesn't show misleading spikes/negatives?

priya: Actioning 1 now. Rolling back rotation for metrics-ingest-targets -> applying old SA keys to consumer pods. ETA ~5m.

engops-bot: Rollback triggered: rotation job rollback/549 at 2026-02-11T02:30:12Z.

priya: Metrics-ingest logs show auth success again from 02:31Z and consumer lag decreasing. No more AuthorizationFailed.

alex_k: Good. Next step: verify aggregator outputs. I ran the rollup query after the fix and see tokens_sec normalizing for recent windows, but negative entries remain for 02:17-02:25. We should backfill those. Also need to check TTFT nulls: likely KV cache per-route got cleared during restart and prefix caching had holes.

support_james: Customer update drafted: "We identified an internal token rotation that briefly broke our metrics ingestion, causing missing TTFT and some negative tokens/sec values in the Console between 02:15–02:32 UTC. We rolled back the rotation and are backfilling affected windows. No billing will be applied for the anomalous negative values; we'll follow up when backfill completes." Want approval from product/legal?

ana_p: Approved to send. Add note we will not charge for the false negatives/spikes and include ETA for backfill.

priya: Backfill plan: run reprocess job for tenant=velox from topic offsets covering 02:10–02:35 (job id backfill-velox-20260211-1). Estimated runtime 12m. Will run in non-prod first then prod reprocess. Starting now.

monitoring_bot: Backfill job started: backfill-velox-20260211-1 at 02:34Z. Estimated rows: ~12k.

alex_k: Also opened a follow-up ticket to add defensive logic in aggregator: if delta < -max_allowed_reset (-1000 tokens) then mark as reset and emit null and write audit record. Ticket ENG-PLAT-4291.

support_james: Copying customer and sending interim note. Thanks team.

priya: Backfill completed at 02:46Z. Verified rollup window corrections for 02:10–02:35; negative entries replaced with proper deltas or nulls where appropriate. Console shows corrected charts for Velox.

monitoring_bot: Alert cleared: metrics-ingest errors < 1/m at 02:47Z.

ana_p: Follow-ups: 1) add post-rotation checklist for SA rotations that includes bumping metrics-ingest creds + smoke check 2) add console annotation UI for "incomplete data" 3) add automated clamp for very large negative deltas.

alex_k: I'll own ENG-PLAT-4291 and the clamp. Priya, please add the rotation checklist to eng-infra runbook.

priya: Will do. Runbook updated and PR opened.

support_james: Closing customer loop now. Velox confirmed console looks good and they appreciate the credit. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
